dispatcher_source_trace.test_cleanup: agentplane/system_tests/test_dispatcher.py:_cleanup_sandbox (lines 114-139) patches running=false; waits for Suspended and then Ready reason Stopped; on timeout it captures diagnostics and re-raises.
dispatcher_source_trace.latched_journal_error: agentplane/runner/journal.go:369-376 checkWritableLocked returns ErrJournalFailed after j.failure is set; Journal.write/WithBatch set failure on canceled transaction/commit/callback paths at lines 507-578.
dispatcher_source_trace.session_teardown: agentplane/runner/session_controller.go:182-255 advances halt, stop, and seal; runner_controller.go:82-109,155-206 waits for sessions halted/stopped, seals, then exact sealed ingress acknowledgements before Quiesced.
dispatcher_source_trace.runtime_correlation: the PendingCommand Lease blocker session ID equals the session-lifecycle and ingress session ID whose journal reports context canceled; runner-gateway holds the Lease at quiesce-stage=draining while the Sandbox is Suspended but Ready=False/Quiescing.
dispatcher_source_trace.limit: No retained journal database or original canceled transaction operation; previous-container log request returned "previous terminated container ... not found". This proves where quiesce stalls and the latched error, but not which original write operation or context owner produced cancellation.

continuity: MCP PR #12496 merged at 06:04:10 Z; VM PR #12495 merged after the source pin. Prior controlled MCP cleanup sums 84.36→23.72 s with both SDKs disabled, runner-only 82.56 s; ten identical cases retained. VM cleanup 49.75→34.86 s while whole action 409.7→415.3 s. These are focused phase results; combined landed CI effect remains unmeasured.

PR #12498 merged at 06:15:11Z, after the collection window and pinned source. One pair: stack Ready 221.8→170.3 s, action 636.3→600.4 s; about 22 s service-readiness tail overlapped, while 29 s varied upstream. Root import remained~65 s. Retain full imports and final readiness; no digest-based skip or fleet estimate.

Eight versus 16 shards retained 48 cases: process 1795.4→1192.3 s, CPU 3624.7→2343.9 s, slowest 132→196 s in one pair. Repeat only as a compute tradeoff. Debundle scale moved to manual in#12486; optimized-CLI automatic-CI proposal is superseded. Trinity#12455 is also a manual-workload improvement.

Phase timing#12308, guest shutdown/storage ordering#12333 and MCP decision reuse#12380 are complete. Prior acceptance: eight clean VM incarnations; BFF XML~44 s shorter across two runs per arm, with unequal startup/snapshot state. Preserve independent Claude/Codex/OOM boots and fresh-session denial; further basic/OAuth grouping was rejected because it changes policy/startup isolation.

iptables lock handling#12248, deadline fix#12189 and selected replay#12254, pre-commit merge-parent selector#12270, and cleanup-diagnostic preservation#12244 are merged. Deadline replay 0/3 and real-lock tests are bounded acceptance, not recurrence-rate estimates. Diagnostic preservation does not repair a stuck cleanup state.

Zero retries#12468 suppresses one client retry path. RPC control resubmitted 105 ms after CANCELLED; a distinct gated action still ran with zero retries. Producer-stop evidence#12482 is merged: one normal same-server completion receipt within 2.302 s; blocked case inconclusive; matched native-client kill fixed within 0.731 s on Bazel 10 development. Hosted lease/stop trace requires an operator. Backport declined; no Bazel upgrade or support request is queued.

Native policy/build overlap#12358 is complete and remeasured here. Affected-artifact selection remains deferred behind the small artifact-last population. Prior burst reached 20 repository-visible runners for 60 m 53 s; visual publication used 5.4% of measured occupancy. Capacity remains conditional on repeat bursts and verified eligible account-wide capacity; no account plan or hosted-executor saturation is established.

VM recycling key#11769 remains; historical imports 198.0→11.7 s are one matched pair, not a fleet effect. Extra Pod key had no benefit. Immutable seeds remain deferred. ctr-local, parallel import and no-unpack probes did not support adoption. Docker opt-out passed four unequal-state runs without a demonstrated gain. Six warmed full/empty workspace pairs added~10.18 s, without reproducing 91.068 s pre-attachment stall.

API image#11506 and deterministic rendering/MCP variants#11746/#11747 are retained; graph cut 14→0 is historical. k 3 s ownership#11871 and Go Actions retirement are complete. Scoped fixtures and DCR component fixtures remain partial/deferred; preserve full ingress/discovery smoke. Leaf-rule narrowing still needs both-revision graph proof and fallback. Broad mypy batching/internal caches remain unproved.

Two-shard VM/MCP pair increased worker-seconds 1.74× and CPU 2.31× for an unmatched 14.6 s wall difference; do not adopt blanket sharding. No VM boot coverage is removed. Prepared Nix check container/combined evaluation remains rejected; host guard stays removed. Cold bytecode/mypy work, publication-tail work and changed-consumer invalidation remain lower priority than measured required gates.

Bridge sharding, PostgreSQL templates, Props prefetch, shallow checkout, warm Bazel, parse-once YAML, Gazelle consolidation and marker/policy cache work retain their original source/window evidence. Their fleet savings are not remeasured here. App/history/auth ownership migrations retain independent correctness gates; no wholesale app-removal saving is assumed.

October 24–27 baseline:2/345 mainline failures,29/129 conclusive PR attempts; five selected same-source recoveries are not a flake rate. CAS eviction, CPU-bound scale timeouts and pre-command startup timeouts are distinct. Old notification/Python and RunnerBridge mechanisms moved owners; do not revive retired-path fixes. Native journal, receipt idempotency, projection readiness and visual capture invariants remain. Source-only Casino/debounce/FreeCAD leads were not re-audited here; Augur port callers migrated and D-Bus example is absent.

Live BuildBuddy status#11827/#11851/#11854 and pagination/source-lineage tooling are retained. Status timestamps, API availability, webhook delivery, inbox admission, harness receipt and complete auto-merge readiness are distinct. This refresh observes native check/job clocks; no delivery schedule, Mimir metric, Shapley allocation or hosted Pages deployment was created.

selection.selectionMethod: Sort assigned canceled bazel-ci / Test & Build job attempts by started_at; choose six evenly spaced indices from the 12 candidates.

limits: A missing cancellation acknowledgment stays unknown; GitHub completed_at is not used as a cancellation time.
A logged acknowledgment does not prove physical worker stop.
Timestamps are compared conservatively because GitHub log acknowledgment time has about one-second resolution.
No synthetic terminal result was interpreted as worker termination.
Read-only audit only; no cancellation, rerun, source, or GitHub mutation was performed.
GetExecution stage=COMPLETED plus an omitted status.code (protobuf default OK) is recorded without claiming an action exit result, successful output artifact, or exclusive work ownership.
Effective retry flags are per child: five explicit remote_retries=0 observations and one exact-tested-source default-5 inference.
GitHub and worker clocks were not calibrated; cross-service timestamp ordering is not a physical-stop measurement.
Completed OK-status records alone do not prove a fresh unshared process or a successful output artifact.
